FLAGGED PLACES:

[P234] 【古代时候】

  proposed by the AI checker: 古代[+的]时候 (needs 的 in 古代的时候)
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction (location_with_zai): [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): [古代的时候→在古代]
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.

[P235] 人不知道【他们】能吃什么植物
  proposed by the AI checker: 人不知道[他们→自己]能吃什么植物 (generic 人 should refer to itself)
  her past correction (question_patterns): 他们不知道什么植物[-能吃]不能吃
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 我们不知道[-我们]可以吃什么植物 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): 大家不知道什么[菜→植物]能吃
  rule card question_patterns: Use 是……吗, V不V, or a Wh-question for an indirect question, not 如果. For “wh-ever…, will do that…”, repeat the Wh-word: 哪一筐……就……哪一筐.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P236] 【所以】有一天
  proposed by the AI checker: [所以→于是]有一天 (于是 connects the resulting action naturally)
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): [一个天时候→有一天]
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 每天[就是→都是]这样
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-然后]
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.
  rule card near_synonym_precision: Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness. Not an error: Do not flag a word simply because it resembles another word. It is not an error when the word’s meaning fits the intended event, duration, possibility, or degree.

[P237] 【神农】出去试一试很多种植物
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦神农⟧出去试一试很多种植物 (first appearance of 神农: briefly introduce who this is)

  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.

[P238] 神农出去【试一试】很多种植物

  her past correction (le_completed): 神农[发现→发现了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P239] 告诉人什么植物是安全【^】什么是危险
  proposed by the AI checker: 告诉人什么植物是安全[+的]什么是危险 (安全 needs 的 in this identifying phrase)

  her past correction (word_class_choice): 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P240] 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险【。】发现有的植物对身体非常好
  proposed by the AI checker: 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险[+的] (危险 needs 的 in this identifying phrase)
  proposed by the AI checker: [+了]发现有的植物对身体非常好 (completed discovery in the narrative needs 了)
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 这些植物对身体[+有]好处
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-这些植物]对身体好处
  her past correction (possessive_reference): 哪些植物对[-你的]健康有好处
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
